why: Company release says Q3 2026 results come at the close on Thursday 2026-10-15, with a call at 16:00-17:00 CDT. Management already pre-guided Q3 EPS down 5-10% from Q2 in mid-September, so part of the print is pre-announced.
session_evidence: Company release: 'at the close of the market Thursday, October 15, 2026', call 4:00-5:00 p.m. CDT. https://finviz.com/news/398058/jb-hunt-transport-services-inc-announces-third-quarter-2026-earnings-release-date-and-conference-call-information
where_to_look: BNSF (BNSF/Berkshire) weekly carload and intermodal unit data for Q3 and early Q4. JBHT intermodal rides BNSF in the West, so it shows the volume trend and the October run-rate the guide will rest on.

Driver and purchased-transportation cost evidence after the September warning: DOE diesel weekly series through quarter-end and into October, and truckload spot and contract rate indices. Ask whether costs moved further after the 2026-09-16 warning, which would put Q3 and the Q4 commentary outside the 5-10% range.
Peer prints this week, for example Knight-Swift or other truckers and railroads reporting mid-October, for read-across on intermodal pricing and bid season.
Dedicated segment net truck adds, and any customer losses or wins named in trade press (FreightWaves).
already_in_the_wire: Mid-September pre-announcement at the Morgan Stanley Laguna conference: Q3 EPS down 5-10% sequentially from Q2 ($1.91), so roughly $1.72-1.81; stock about -10% that day
Cause cited: higher fuel, purchased transportation and driver recruitment costs (Barclays target cut)
Q2 2026: EPS $1.91 vs $1.71 est., revenue +19%, record intermodal loads (578k)
Consensus $1.81 equals the top of the pre-guided range
trades_on: The reported quarter, plus intermodal volume. Q2 2026 rose +8.0% on an EPS beat ($1.91 vs $1.71) and record intermodal volume (https://secure.businesswire.com/news/home/20260715520827/en/J.B.-Hunt-Transport-Services-Inc.-Reports-U.S.-GAAP-Revenues-Net-Earnings-and-Earnings-Per-Share-for-the-Second-Quarter-2026). It fell about 10% on the 2026-09 intra-quarter cost warning (https://stocktwits.com/news-articles/markets/equity/j-b-hunt-warns-near-term-earnings-will-fall-barclays-flags-higher-costs-but-sees-freight-demand-inflection/cZtYLJKRB2M). The bar is now the pre-guided range, not the old consensus.
short_interest: about 2.7M shares, 2.9% of float, 2.3 days to cover, Equibles snapshot ~2026-08-19 (https://equibles.com/stocks/JBHT). Benzinga showed 3.3% in early August.
